scope: D3D8 single-buffer additional swap-chain backbuffers expose their device through GetContainer(IUnknown/IDirect3DDevice8), without revealing the private render-target texture. GetContainer adds exactly one relative device reference and remains valid while a surface is held after chain Release. Preserve ordinary 2D/cube texture and implicit device containers, rejected-IID output clearing and NULL-output status. Public backbuffer COM counters, independent zero-count revival/device pin counts, D3D9 chain containers, standalone render/depth containers, multiple buffers, original Microsoft HAL, games/FPS and review stages 4/5/6 remain incomplete. Host/protocol/shaders unchanged; no new GPU pixel run in this phase.

sources.evidence: Pinned Windows test_refcount at additional swap-chain backbuffer: GetContainer(IID_IDirect3DDevice8) must return the device. D3D8 uses a device container here; the D3D9 test expects its swap chain instead.
GetContainer delegates QueryInterface to the retained surface container; backing storage alone does not define the public container.
